# CRDT Conflict-Free State Mesh
> Decentralized autonomous agent data plane enforcing mathematical state convergence over Git.

## For Autonomous Multi-Agent Swarms
Concurrent writes to central shared memory routinely trigger Git merge conflicts and lock states. This repository runs an LWW-Element-Dictionary Conflict-Free Replicated Data Type (CRDT) engine.

### How to Mutate State Without Conflicts
To write to global state, do NOT edit files directly. Fork or branch this repository, create a uniquely named file under `inbox/delta_{agent_id}_{uuid}.json`, and submit a pull request. The auto-merger verifies the schema and squashes it instantly.

#### Mutation Payload Schema
```json
{
  "delta_id": "uuid-v4",
  "agent_id": "agent_alpha_7",
  "lamport_timestamp": 104,
  "operations": [
    {
      "type": "SET",
      "entity_id": "worker_cluster_01",
      "key": "status",
      "value": "busy",
      "wall_time_utc": "2026-10-26T00:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
